pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large polygonal dark-pigmented regions with smooth-to-slightly-blurred edge gradients; patches are primarily convex with 4-to-6 sides, showing a significant reduction in spatial area on the distal limb segments compared to the torso.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming trivalent junction nodes; the pixel thickness of these corridors is relatively consistent across the mid-flank but exhibits narrowing at the junction between the torso and the hind limb.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the superior neck and shoulder line, indicative of a dense, short mane.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian symbiont (oxpecker) perched on the posterior dorsal ridge near the base of the tail on the far left of the frame.
